subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

What the council neglected to examine thoroughly (1)/ were not the aims of the draft itself, (2)/ but the broader implications it (3)/ might have triggered without wider approval. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in the usage of the verb "**were**" in part 2 of the sentence.
 
• The subject of the sentence, "**what the council neglected to examine thoroughly**," is singular, and therefore the verb should be "**was**" instead of "were."
 
• Correct subject-verb agreement ensures grammatical correctness.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"What the council neglected to examine thoroughly was not the aims of the draft itself, but the broader implications it might have triggered without wider approval."*
